notes:
Original primary full text unavailable via DOI/publisher, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, institutional record and targeted open-access manuscript searches. Statistics describing the original in the replication article were not substituted for primary original evidence. Replication 2 is the corrected, no-typo attempt; main analysis uses robust standard errors (footnote 7), and includes all retained participants rather than the footnote 8 prior-participation subset. Success records the replication authors’ narrative for the assigned second attempt; the article describes the two attempts jointly as mixed.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind validation. Source is the supplied published Journal of Consumer Research article, pp. 508–527, with 2019 print year and 2018 advance-access date; no manuscript or appendix substituted. Supplied locator p. 28 does not correspond to the published pagination; the neutral description and Study 3 uniquely locate the large-group independence simple slope on published p. 518. Rendered PDF pages 10–12 inspected directly. The canonical frozen text renders the printed Greek beta as b and equals signs as ¼; quotations preserve those exact canonical glyphs. The rendered page confirms beta .38, t(239) = 3.22 and exact p = .002 for the same test. No metric conversion. Study-wide N = 250 is retained as context rather than asserted as test-specific analytic n. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
